info.title: Keldrin API
info.description: Verified corporate-action records for Coinbase tokenized stocks (B20) on Base. Read-only, informational; not an oracle or investment advice. Only independently CONFIRMED records are served. WAD values are exact integer strings scaled by 1e18. Read-only. Rate limited per client; successful reads are cached up to 60 s at the CDN.
info.x-guidance: Free one-stock routes under /v1. One-call snapshot (/v1/snapshot) and report (/v1/report?token=) give 3 free complete answers per client per day, then 402 FREE_TRIES_USED with the paid links. Paid: GET /api/snapshot and /api/report (forward to Bankr x402 Cloud): x402 v2, scheme exact, network eip155:8453, USDC, amount 50000 ($0.05), payTo 0x8AEE621035D93Deb3C0C1177fac252dC2dd501a0. Sign once, never re-sign automatically; only a 2xx is charged. Agent guide: https://keldrin.vercel.app/skill.md

get.summary: Tracked tokens with identity state and current multiplier

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Exact token symbol (e.g. GOOGLc). Prefer contract.

200.description: Record, review, revisions and company context

company_context.description: SEC reconciliation (record_type=reconciliation); null when none is confirmed for this revision.

get.summary: Declared dividends and the date each token is expected to adjust (leading calendar)
get.description: Entries come from SEC filing text (quote, document URL and sha256) and are independently re-verified. expected_adjustment_date is the payable date: an observed issuer pattern whose measured rate is stated in each entry's basis, not a guarantee.

get.summary: Applied and upcoming corporate actions in one list
Events added or whose status changed since a timestamp (poll with meta.as_of)
Chainlink NAV history for one token (verified feeds only)
get.description: Verbatim Chainlink rounds with feed, phase, aggregator and round id per point, so each value can be re-read onchain with getRoundData. Total-return NAV: it already includes dividends and splits. Official rounds only by default: inside the window in which the proxy served that aggregator, from an aggregator whose decimals match the proxy. interval=daily returns the last official round inside each New York trading day's regular session; trading days without one are listed in meta.quality.missing_trading_days and never filled. Served only when the feed's latest independent review is CONFIRMED, and only rounds that review covered. Returns 503 NAV_NOT_ENABLED until enabled by the operator.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: all (interval=round only) also returns non-official rounds with official/proxy_live/decimals_ok flags

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: round interval only; pass meta.next_cursor back unchanged (order: updated_at, then round_id)

404.description: Unknown token (UNKNOWN_ASSET) or no NAV feed (NO_NAV_FEED)

503.description: Not enabled (NAV_NOT_ENABLED) or feed not independently verified (NAV_NOT_VERIFIED)

get.summary: US equity session right now (NYSE calendar 2026-2027)
Session, latest Chainlink NAV (live, with round id and age) and staleness for one token
get.description: The latest round is read live from Base's public RPC (reused up to 30 s in the server; responses are not CDN-cached) and served only if its phase was covered by the latest CONFIRMED review with matching decimals. staleness (method v2): trading (regular-session) seconds since the round, across days, against threshold = max(2 × the feed's p99 in-session gap, 30 min): fresh | expected_closed | unexpectedly_stale | unknown | calendar_not_covered. Failures degrade to nav: null with nav_unavailable_reason (no_nav_feed, feed_not_verified, rpc_unavailable, rpc_result_invalid, phase_not_reviewed, aggregator_decimals_differ_from_proxy). dex: the main verified pool's price, venue, pool, block, 2% depth and nav_premium_pct (DEX vs last published NAV), with a note when the market is closed. Returns 503 NAV_NOT_ENABLED until enabled.

get.summary: One token's verified corporate actions with multiplier and uiMultiplier detail
get.description: Same events as /v1/events for the token, plus operator description, announced_at, effective block/time, ui_multiplier_before/after_wad and its effective time (when the UIMultiplierUpdated event exists), announcement transactions and evidence links (onchain tx, Coinbase issuer record, SEC filing, Keldrin record).

get.summary: Live DEX price of a tokenized stock on Base (onchain, one pinned block)
get.description: Reads Keldrin's independently verified pools (Uniswap v3, Aerodrome v2, Aerodrome Slipstream and plain no-hook Uniswap v4 pools against USDC, WETH or ETH) at one block from Base's public RPC. Per pool: price per token in the quote and in USD (ETH priced from the Uniswap v3 WETH/USDC 0.05% pool), estimated 2% depth in USD, status (ok, too_thin, outlier, unsupported, unreadable). main = deepest pool with depth >= $100 and price within 0.25x-4x of the median; thin_market when depth < $1,000. Never CDN-cached.

200.description: DEX price (main may be null with unavailable_reason)

post.summary: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON; no SSE)
post.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per POST (max 64 KB): initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. Read-only tools: list_assets, get_corporate_actions, get_nav_history, get_market_context, get_dex_price, get_market_session. Tool results carry a plain lead sentence, the JSON, and structuredContent; API errors come back as isError with the same codes as the REST API. Add with: claude mcp add --transport http keldrin https://keldrin.vercel.app/mcp

get.summary: All verified stocks in one answer (3 free per day)
get.description: Every Coinbase tokenized stock on Base with a verified Chainlink NAV feed, in one answer: latest NAV with round id and age, freshness, main DEX price with depth and gap vs NAV, next corporate action; plus the US session. 3 free complete answers per client per UTC day (shared with /v1/report), then 402 FREE_TRIES_USED with the paid x402 links. Incomplete answers are 503 and use no try.

get.summary: Agent guide (when to use keldrin, how to read answers, how to pay)

ticker.description: B20 token symbol, e.g. NVDAc. Store contract_address, not the ticker.

status.description: predicted: declared/announced, not applied yet. confirmed_onchain: applied, no dated company declaration matched. verified_matched: applied and matches the declared payable date. late: applied (or expected) more than 1 day after the payable date.

confidence.description: high: two independent sources agree (SEC declaration and onchain). medium: one source. Never guessed.

expected_adjustment_date.description: Payable date of the declaration (observed issuer pattern, not a guarantee). null when no dated declaration is evidenced.

multiplier_delta.description: after/before as an exact decimal string

warnings.description: Anything that does not add up beyond timing, e.g. multiplier_change_unusually_large_for_cash_dividend. Any warning lowers confidence.

round_id.description: proxy round id (phaseId<<64 | aggregatorRoundId), decimal string

provisional.description: daily interval only: true while that session has not closed yet

official.description: include=all only: inside its phase's live window and decimals match the proxy

proxy_live.description: include=all only: the proxy served this round's aggregator when it was published

decimals_ok.description: include=all only: the aggregator's decimals equal the proxy's
